name: WdConditionCode
description: Specifies the area of a table to which to apply special style formatting.

constants.name: wdFirstRow
constants.description: Applies formatting to the first row in a table.

constants.name: wdLastRow
constants.description: Applies formatting to the last row in a table.

constants.name: wdFirstColumn
constants.description: Applies formatting to the first column in a table.

constants.name: wdLastColumn
constants.description: Applies formatting to the last column in a table.

constants.name: wdNECell
constants.description: Applies formatting to the last cell in the first row.

constants.name: wdNWCell
constants.description: Applies formatting to the first cell in the first row.

constants.name: wdSECell
constants.description: Applies formatting to the last cell in the table.

constants.name: wdSWCell
